assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a high-end editorial travel photograph to use as a FICTIONAL DESIGN MOCKUP for the Mexican couple travel/vlog brand AL DESTINO. A sophisticated coastal Mexican boutique hotel terrace with an infinity pool, sculptural pale plaster architecture, a single palm and warm terracotta lounge furniture, expansive turquoise ocean and hazy mountains in the distance. Wide horizontal 16:9 framing, camera low enough for strong architectural foreground, warm early morning sunlight, tactile materials, rich natural shadows, premium travel magazine art direction, understated film color and depth, no oversaturation. Composition: visually compelling architecture/pool on right two-thirds, darker palm/shadow foreground on left third leaving natural negative space for later typography. Absolutely NO text, NO logos, NO people, NO signage, no real recognizable property, no collage. This is a fictional visual sample, not evidence of a visit. Aim for exceptional photographic detail and art direction rather than a generic resort stock image.
